signals.summary: Travel outlets are pushing 'hidden' scenic nature destinations — volcanic landscapes, hilly nature preserves with seasonal waterfalls, and mountain hot-springs towns — as under-the-radar late-summer/early-autumn trips.
signals.why_now: Two fresh Travel+Leisure pieces in the last day (highest-rated volcanic-landscape national park, 21.2h; Colorado hot-springs adventure town, 10h) plus two islands.com nature-preserve/seasonal-waterfall features; scenic-landscape angle rises heading into foliage season.

signals.summary: 'Chaos gardening' — scatter-sowing seeds for a wild, low-effort naturalistic bed — keeps drawing coverage across mainstream and lifestyle press, riding late-summer sowing and native-plant interest.
signals.why_now: Sustained multi-outlet wave (NYT, Vogue, Good Housekeeping, Tom's Guide, veranda, Hartford Courant, Axios native-plants Massachusetts) with the most recent hit ~750h; seasonally live as late-summer/autumn sowing window is open.

signals.summary: A nostalgic, romantic garden look is trending — 'grandma gardens', French potager/cottage style, and roses planted into wildflower meadows — all soft, layered, heirloom planting.
signals.why_now: Three independent lifestyle features converge on the same heirloom/cottage aesthetic (House Beautiful grandma gardens, Apartment Therapy French garden, The Times roses-in-meadows most recent at ~510h); evergreen visual that photographs beautifully in late-summer bloom.

signals.summary: The autumn-hiking season kickoff is here — 'fall hiking essentials' roundups and reports of surging, broadening outdoor-recreation participation frame trails, foliage and crisp-weather scenery for the season.
signals.why_now: Recent seasonal signals: USA TODAY '15 fall hiking essentials to shop now' (52h) and National Law Review 'surge in outdoor recreation participation / new demographics' (68h), on top of a broad standing hiking-interest base; timing aligns with late-August turn to autumn.

signals.summary: Seasonal foraging and phenology (reading nature's calendar — what's ripening and blooming when) is a recurring late-summer/harvest-season theme, good for foraged-food and seasonal-plant visuals.
signals.why_now: Foraging content is seasonally live (Illinois Extension seasonal foraging course, ~356h) alongside evergreen phenology explainers (Old Farmer's Almanac, Press Democrat); harvest/foraging interest rises into early autumn.

signals.summary: Atlas Obscura's steady drip of curious, off-map places — an island of stacked Volvos, a lone New Mexico cabin, a Norwegian tunnel — offers evocative single-frame 'strange place' subjects.
signals.why_now: A batch of fresh Atlas Obscura entries all landed in the last ~1-2 days (Volvo Island 17h, Missing Cabin NM 17h, Fyllingsdalstunnelen Norway 23h); single-source RSS wave but consistently recent and highly image-ready.

signals.summary: 'Gorpcore' stylish hiking gear — technical sneakers, GORE-TEX collabs, cult hiking sandals — continues as an aesthetic wave; usable as object/gear flatlay content though the trend leans fashion-on-body.
signals.why_now: Ongoing gear-fashion cluster with recent entries (Margaret Howell x Mizuno GORE-TEX sneaker 88h, gorpcore cool-girl trend 342h, $50 hiking sandal 414h); broad outlet spread but body/fashion focus caps producibility.
